title: Sequence spaces, closed sets, and perfect kernels
proposed_reference_coverage: **Sequence spaces: cylinders, closed sets, and perfect kernels**
fact_or_context_to_reference: Finite-prefix cones become basic open cylinders, and tree bodies are closed. The largest perfect subtree and countable remainder supply the closed-set perfect kernel; passing from a family of paths to its prefix tree can add paths. All required combinatorics is proved locally.
